ext.description: Cursor-style coding agent for VS Code powered by Hermes Agent over ACP, with your own model endpoint.
ext.untrusted: The Hermes agent is disabled until the workspace is trusted.
cfg.path: Path to the `hermes` executable. Leave empty to search `PATH` and the default install location.
cfg.mode: Which endpoint Hermes uses. `hermes` keeps your own Hermes config; `custom` runs Hermes with an IDE-owned profile pointed at the base URL and model below.
cfg.mode.hermes: Use the provider and model from your Hermes config.
cfg.mode.custom: Use the base URL, model and API key set in Hermes IDE.
cfg.baseUrl: OpenAI-compatible base URL for `custom` mode, e.g. `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` or `http://localhost:11434/v1`.
cfg.contextLength: Context window of the custom model in tokens (0 = auto-detect). Hermes needs at least 64,000.
cfg.language: Language of the Hermes panel. `auto` follows the VS Code display language.
